source.source_status: Existing retained export fetched through GitHub blob. Original XML hashes imported, original bytes not reverified. All extracted facts remain UNREVIEWED except the exact quarterly PAT/text comparisons in three supplemental cases.

selection: Choose consolidated if available, otherwise standalone; no fallback after scope chosen. Exclude missing PAT, exact-period/clock/ISIN or ownership reconciliation issue. Rank eligible ISIN using fixed FNV-1a salt and take first 100. Not random sample of NSE or BSE; retained acquisition universe is selective. No price, profitability or future outcome criterion. Exclusion of missing data is coverage bias. No changed frozen cohort.

baseline_definitions.accounting_driver: 0.5 of observed sequential revenue change, clipped +/-10%; weight most recent PBT margin and tax rate 2/3; weighted NCI. Abstain for missing bridge, financial-sector flag, loss/unstable tax or exceptional-item evidence. No sign correction, no imputation. Deterministic accounting comparator, not AI.
baseline_definitions.enhanced: Nested convenience sample with previous substantive company research and newly checked source text. Add seasonal naive, additive seasonal, normalized additive seasonal, raw and normalized YoY ratio when prior PAT positive, and analyst-selected business drivers. Not blind or independent.

primary_metric: Absolute error scaled by max(1 crore, abs(Q1 PAT), abs(Q2 PAT)) frozen per issuer. Different from four-company pilot denominator, do not pool. Primary paired comparisons are latest-quarter vs other methods on exactly the same observed rows; enhanced methods also compared pairwise against each available seasonal comparator. Report coverage and missing cases, both methods' same-subset scores, wins/ties/losses and signed errors. No p-value/promotion from small sample.
